hints.title: Two-Phase Conversion
hints.text: Notice that Day 1 conversions can be decoupled from Day 2 conversions, computing maximum holdings for each currency.

hints.title: Multiplicative Graph Search
hints.text: Build graphs where edges represent exchange rates and reverse edges represent inverse rates.

hints.title: Round-Trip Conversion
hints.text: From each currency held at the end of Day 1, compute maximum initial currency retrievable using Day 2 rates.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-phase multiplicative breadth-first search finding best Day 1 holdings then converting back to initial currency on Day 2.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive permutation of all conversion sequences causes unbounded cycles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory storing graph edges and best exchange ratios.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Runs separate BFS passes for Day 1 and Day 2 to maximize end currency balance.
